body:
**Research theorem / scoped negative result; no new kappa.**

This proves a uniform rank formula for global proper stars on signed k-subset ports, and the sharp algebraic all-target puncture threshold when k is a power of two. Granting the global sum adds one dimension exactly when k is a power of two and p >= 2k-1. In the 1,120-port (8,4) geometry, nonempty stars can retain at most **447** simultaneously decodable ports (673 deletions); granting the empty star permits **448** (672 deletions). Both limits have literal attaining decoders.

The proof separates sign monomials and applies the integral unsigned inclusion basis of Ghorbani et al., arXiv:0709.3144v1. PR #747 already supplies the finite (6,4) all-target threshold85 and information-set argument; those are credited corroboration. This adds the uniform formula and identifies a boundary invisible in that smaller geometry. PR #732's correction-absorption mechanism and #669/#231's paired-star lineage are credited. No predecessor executable code is imported.

Only `research/paired-star-rank/` is added. Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Source heads, inspected-byte hashes, OS-random seed46, candidate selection and the local sprint claim are included. No pinned coordination issue existed. Accepted kappa and `upstream/` remain unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/paired-star-rank/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/paired-star-rank/test_verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_PAIRED_STAR_RANK: 36 cases; (8,4) ranks 447/448; all-target deletions 673/672; 8 negative controls; kappa unchanged`, followed by four passing test groups.

Validation passed on Windows Python3.11.15 and local Linux Python3.12.3, including optimized isolated mode, byte-identical regeneration, relocated minimal-input replay, modified-input rejection and preservation of prior output on failure. The separate verifier performs no elimination: 2,706 explicit unit decoders prove the lower bounds and 3,714 full-family spanning identities prove the upper bounds. Selected-record/source integrity and whitespace checks pass. The unchanged broad supplier suites were not repeated; no hosted CI or formal multiplication-proof pass is claimed.

The result concerns unrestricted scalar star identities, not preparation cost, dirty restoration, legal frames, hosting or a paid recursive supplier. More retained ports are impossible within the stated decoder class even with zero implementation cost; the attaining information sets have no priced construction. Inherited compiler, precision/tape/recovery and analytic assumptions remain.

Prepared by **ellipsi2 (@ellipsi2)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including one scoped AI proof review, under Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed. Pre-submission overlap refresh covered 586 open PRs through #767 and found no duplicate uniform-rank result.
title: Research: uniform proper-star ranks and all-target puncture thresholds
